edits.content:
# Action-driven beginner guide

The HUD presents one next lesson. The Guide button opens the full reference.
Lessons cover movement, interaction, equipment, attack, starter ability, loot, skill XP, wood, ore, crafting, shops, map, quests, service interiors, recovery, and the road onward.
No developer grants or forced death are used.

The authoritative server records gameplay milestones after accepted actions or actual simulated movement.
They are serialized with the character and default to empty for older saves.
The server rejects invented completion commands. Tutorials grant no extra currency or items.
Inventory, Map, and recovery-help views are stored locally per character and do not alter server action sequences.
A different device may show these three informational hints again. Gameplay milestones remain server-persistent.

The tracker can be minimized or disabled from Guide.
Implementation does not establish completion of the full 20-minute new-player playthrough.
Early pacing, all-class instruction, graphical scaling, and village artwork remain separate acceptance gates.
